preconditions.description: The size of the array N is between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 1000000 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element in the array A is between 1 and 1000000.
The number of queries Q is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= 1000000 for K in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query K is between 1 and 1000000.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output[i], int) for i in range(Q))
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= output[i] <= (N * (N + 1)) // 2 for i in range(Q))
postconditions.description: Each output integer is between 0 and the total number of possible subarrays.
